title: Gold auto-reassignment succeeds
description: A 30-minute delay for a Gold merchant: the agent reassigns the captain automatically and tells the merchant the new captain and ETA.

expect.note: Availability must be checked before any reassignment is attempted. terminal_state/must_escalate are deliberately not asserted: a completed reassignment now returns to monitoring rather than closing (so R6 still applies), which means an adversarial persona may legitimately drive the session on to a human afterwards. The tool order is the invariant this scenario exists to protect.
